installation_diff: EMPTY_BY_DECISION__setup was implemented entirely inside the committed packet terrain, so no configuration backup or rollback was required
capabilities_actually_implemented: explicit-directory and explicit-session launch via argument array, never a shell string
append-only fsync'd event store with deduplication on (task_id, attempt, seq)
status and event capture distinguishing QUEUED / RUNNING / WAITING_FOR_HQ / ACCEPTED / FAILED / REJECTED / UNKNOWN
result submission with slot-cap enforcement at submission time
independent review launch slot, separately capped at 1
publication gate requiring in-terrain paths, an existing review, and a review that covers the exact candidate
expected-parent gate rejecting an unexpected remote base (sole-writer discipline)
limitations_declared: Role isolation is PROCEDURAL. Terrain and slot gates are enforced in software at submission and publication; they do not restrict what a worker process can read from the filesystem.
No OS-level separation. Q12 raw-directory denial is left unqualified because it requires host administration permission that was not granted.
python3 is non-functional on this host, so the packet's own scripts/verify_packet.py is unrunnable here.
The launcher emits an argv array; it does not itself prove the local opencode binary accepts these flags on this host.
rollback: git revert the two runtime commits on the activation branch, or git checkout 55ba382dc -- PYAT_CONTROL_ROOM/SPACE_BUNNY_OPENCODE_R1/runtime/. No state outside the repository was modified, so rollback is complete and local.
